name: this game will end in 205 clicks.
source:
👑 What does a SUPERVILLAIN do, when he is forbidden from doing anything evil for the day? 👑

This is it!!! ROYAL the SUPERVILLAIN has finally completed his SUPER KINGLY WEAPON. Thanks to it, he can finally end the reign of the heroes of CITYVILLE, the GIRLS!

But, what's this? There's a maintenance? Because of it, he can't enact any evil deeds today?

Well, it's all fine! There's lots to do today. So watch ROYAL yap on and on about his job, about his past, about what it means to be ☒☒☒☒☒, and smile at his funny antics!

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3585630/this_game_will_end_in_205_clicks/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
👑 当超级恶棍当天被禁止做任何恶事时他会做什么？👑

就是这个！！！超级恶棍皇家终于完成了他的超级王者武器。多亏了它，他终于可以结束CITYVILLE英雄女孩们的统治！

但是，这是什么？有维修吗？就因为这样，他今天就不能再做坏事了？

嗯，一切都好！今天有很多事情要做。因此，观看ROYAL喋喋不休地谈论他的工作、他的过去、☒☒☒☒☒意味着什么，并为他滑稽的滑稽动作微笑！

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3585630/this_game_will_end_in_205_clicks/]Steam[/url]]
